column2: Paste before every TEX- Image Description: "Seamless, tileable, hand-painted game texture viewed straight from above or straight-on (orthographic, no perspective, no horizon). Painterly brush strokes with clean bold shapes, matching a whimsical young-adult indie RPG with painterly card art (same look as our approved town grass, wildflower, and stone textures). Flat, even, neutral lighting: no cast shadows, no highlights from one direction, no vignette. Evenly distributed detail with no single focal point, so it repeats well. The left and right edges must match and the top and bottom edges must match, so the image tiles seamlessly. No text, no letters, no border, no objects that stick out as a single focal point. Square, 1024x1024."

Paste before every DEC- Image Description: "A single hand-painted decal for a whimsical young-adult indie RPG with painterly card art, viewed straight from above (orthographic). Painterly brush strokes, clean shapes, flat even lighting with no cast shadows. An irregular, organic shape centered in the frame with soft, naturally fading edges, surrounded by a fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). It will be layered on top of ground and wall textures, so it must blend naturally (no hard rectangular edges). No text, no letters, no border. Square, 1024x1024."

Save each image as its ID (e.g. TEX-GAIN-GRASS.png) to Card Game Art / Pending Review; approved files move to Card Game Art / Approved_Textures. Generate each zone's set in one ChatGPT conversation so the palette stays consistent. TEX-MAT rows are shared building and prop materials used in every zone (Claude maps the existing models' flat colors onto them). The three TEX-TOWN textures from the test are already approved.
